visual_symptoms.label: oil_pressure
visual_symptoms.meaning: Oil level too low or oil pump failure
visual_symptoms.driver_action: Pull over safely and switch off; check oil level; do not drive on
visual_symptoms.caveat: Some cars show this amber for low level

visual_symptoms.label: coolant_temperature
visual_symptoms.driver_action: Pull over and switch off; do not open a hot radiator cap

visual_symptoms.label: brake_system
visual_symptoms.meaning: Low brake fluid / handbrake on / pad wear sensor
visual_symptoms.driver_action: Check handbrake; if still lit stop and call for help

visual_symptoms.label: battery_charging
visual_symptoms.what_the_camera_sees: Battery symbol lit while engine runs
visual_symptoms.driver_action: Car runs on battery only — drive straight to a workshop or stop
visual_symptoms.caveat: May stall when battery is flat

visual_symptoms.label: airbag_srs
visual_symptoms.what_the_camera_sees: Seated person with airbag circle lit
visual_symptoms.meaning: Airbag system fault — may not deploy

visual_symptoms.label: check_engine_flashing
visual_symptoms.meaning: Serious misfire that can damage the catalyst
visual_symptoms.caveat: Flashing is more serious than steady

visual_symptoms.label: abs
visual_symptoms.meaning: Anti-lock braking offline (normal brakes still work)

visual_symptoms.label: traction_esp
visual_symptoms.meaning: Stability control fault or switched off

visual_symptoms.label: tyre_pressure
visual_symptoms.meaning: One or more tyres about 20–25% under-inflated
visual_symptoms.driver_action: Inflate at the next station; check for puncture

visual_symptoms.label: ev_reduced_power
visual_symptoms.meaning: EV/hybrid limp-home: low battery or overheating
visual_symptoms.driver_action: Drive gently to a charger or dealer

visual_symptoms.label: ev_battery_temperature
visual_symptoms.meaning: Traction battery too hot or cold
visual_symptoms.driver_action: Avoid DC fast charging; dealer check if it persists

visual_symptoms.label: coolant
visual_symptoms.what_the_camera_sees: Puddle under the radiator / front engine area
visual_symptoms.driver_action: Check coolant level; watch the temperature gauge; fix promptly to avoid overheating
visual_symptoms.caveat: Pink/red coolant overlaps with transmission fluid colour — use location

visual_symptoms.label: transmission_fluid
visual_symptoms.what_the_camera_sees: Puddle under the gearbox (middle of car)

visual_symptoms.label: power_steering_fluid
visual_symptoms.what_the_camera_sees: Puddle near the front wheels / steering rack

visual_symptoms.label: engine_oil
visual_symptoms.what_the_camera_sees: Puddle under the engine (oil pan / valve cover / sump plug)

visual_symptoms.label: brake_fluid
visual_symptoms.what_the_camera_sees: Wet patch near a wheel or under the pedal area
visual_symptoms.caveat: Hard to separate from oil by colour only — ask about location and smell

visual_symptoms.label: washer_fluid
visual_symptoms.what_the_camera_sees: Drip near the front of the car

visual_symptoms.label: ac_condensate
visual_symptoms.what_the_camera_sees: Drip near the front passenger footwell area

visual_symptoms.label: white_thin_cold_start
visual_symptoms.what_the_camera_sees: Thin vapour that disappears after warm-up

visual_symptoms.label: white_thick_persistent
visual_symptoms.meaning: Coolant entering the engine (e.g. failed head gasket)
visual_symptoms.driver_action: Stop and check coolant; risk of engine failure

visual_symptoms.label: blue
visual_symptoms.meaning: Engine burning oil (valve seals / piston rings / turbo)

visual_symptoms.label: grey
visual_symptoms.meaning: Oil burning / faulty PCV valve / transmission fluid leak (automatic)
visual_symptoms.driver_action: Professional inspection; urgent if transmission fluid

visual_symptoms.label: black
visual_symptoms.meaning: Petrol: too much fuel (air filter / injectors); diesel: soot / DPF
visual_symptoms.driver_action: Check the air filter first; injectors at a workshop

model_faults.symptom_en: Rust on bonnet / underbody / lower doors / rear arches / sills
model_faults.symptom_ru: Кузов ржавеет: капот днище низ дверей задние арки пороги
model_faults.likely_cause: Weak factory paint and no galvanising
model_faults.repair_action: Anti-corrosion treatment of surfaces and hidden cavities; watch the sills

model_faults.likely_cause: Oil pan and valve-cover gaskets
model_faults.repair_action: Replace gaskets; leaks can damage the timing belt and HT leads

model_faults.likely_cause: Throttle-position / idle sensor / HT leads / ignition coils / distributor sensor hates moisture

model_faults.symptom_en: Gear selection becomes very tight; gearbox needs oil top-ups; final-drive seal leaks
model_faults.symptom_ru: Передачи включаются туго; нужен долив масла; течёт сальник привода
model_faults.likely_cause: Worn synchronisers / bushings / shift linkage
model_faults.repair_action: Replace synchros / bushings / linkage rods; watch the seal

model_faults.symptom_en: Soft wallowing ride; rear sags; springs break
model_faults.symptom_ru: Мягкая раскачивающаяся подвеска; задок проседает; лопаются пружины
model_faults.likely_cause: Front shocks rarely last past 60000 km on local roads; weak rear springs
model_faults.typical_mileage: front shocks ~60000 km; major repair ~80000 km
model_faults.repair_action: Replace front shocks and rear springs

model_faults.symptom_en: Frequent small electrical faults; battery light
model_faults.likely_cause: Alternator (bearings / diode bridge)
model_faults.repair_action: Repair alternator bearings or diode bridge

model_faults.symptom_en: Ticking / knocking from the top of the engine
model_faults.likely_cause: Valve clearances drift (no hydraulic lifters); camshaft wear by ~100000 km if ignored
model_faults.repair_action: Valve clearance adjustment by selecting tappets

model_faults.symptom_en: Oil leaks at crankshaft seals and valve cover
model_faults.symptom_ru: Течи масла через сальники коленвала и прокладку клапанной крышки
model_faults.likely_cause: Clogged crankcase ventilation
Solenoid block and 4-5-6 drum; tendency to overheat (early units worse)
model_faults.repair_action: Fluid change every 40000–60000 km; preventive teardown

model_faults.likely_cause: Ball joints and rear shock absorbers wear out
Early rack seal wear (not on every car)
Hose ageing
Expansion tank cracks regularly

model_faults.symptom_en: Humming alternator; bulbs burn out often; seat heater fails
model_faults.symptom_ru: Гудит генератор; часто перегорают лампы; отказ подогрева сидений
model_faults.likely_cause: Alternator bearing; bulbs; seat heater
Release bearing has unstable life
Water pump wear
model_faults.repair_action: Replace pump together with the timing belt (belt every 60000 km)

model_faults.symptom_en: Oil seepage; oil in spark-plug wells; oil in coolant
model_faults.symptom_ru: Подтекает масло; масло в свечных колодцах; масло в антифризе
model_faults.likely_cause: Valve-cover / camshaft seals / oil-cooler gaskets harden
Ignition coil failure (poor fuel and bad plugs make it worse)
Gear selector position sensor
model_faults.repair_action: Replace sensor; fluid at 60000 then every 30000 km

model_faults.symptom_en: Knocks in steering over bumps; rack leaks
model_faults.likely_cause: Rack design weakness
Caliper guide pins seize from corrosion

model_faults.symptom_en: Driver's door sags and closes badly
model_faults.likely_cause: Hinge wear

model_faults.symptom_en: Rust on underbody / sills / door bottoms / rear arches
model_faults.symptom_ru: Ржавчина днища порогов низа дверей задних арок
model_faults.likely_cause: No factory galvanising
model_faults.repair_action: Treat at first signs; underbody protection every 2–3 years
model_faults.caveat: Generation mapping to Uzbek M300 not confirmed

model_faults.likely_cause: Throttle / idle / MAP sensors; HT leads and coils; distributor gets wet (0.8)
model_faults.repair_action: Replace ignition parts; timing belt + rollers + pump every 40000–60000 km

model_faults.symptom_ru: Передачи включаются туго или с хрустом
model_faults.likely_cause: Worn synchros; seized clutch / shift cables; worn clutch

model_faults.symptom_en: Noise / vibration from the rear; later body sway
model_faults.likely_cause: Rear hub bearings (pressed into drums); rear shocks
model_faults.typical_mileage: noise from 30000 km; sway from 80000 km

model_faults.likely_cause: Rack bushings and tie-rod joints wear
Rear wheel cylinders and auto-adjusters seize (dirt / corrosion)
model_faults.repair_action: Clean and lubricate rear brakes at every service

model_faults.symptom_en: Doors hard to open or close; handles loosen
model_faults.likely_cause: Door frames deform with sharp temperature swings (as reported)
model_faults.caveat: Not the US Chevrolet Cobalt (2005–2010) — US recalls do not apply

model_faults.symptom_en: Windows fog up quickly in cold weather
model_faults.likely_cause: Not stated in source

model_faults.applies_to: vans sold in Korea in 2009 (135 units)
model_faults.likely_cause: Manufacturing defect (Korean-market recall)
model_faults.caveat: Historic Korea-only recall. We found NO solid source on typical Damas faults — needs local mechanic interviews

model_faults.symptom_en: Recall — power-steering column controller may crack; short circuit / overheating / fire risk
model_faults.symptom_ru: Отзыв — трещины контроллера ЭУР; риск КЗ и возгорания
model_faults.likely_cause: CEPS controller board micro-cracks from tool cover contact
model_faults.repair_action: Dealer fits an insulation pad free of charge
model_faults.caveat: China-market recall — check VIN with BYD dealer

model_faults.symptom_en: Petrol engine starts by itself in EV mode
model_faults.symptom_ru: Двигатель запускается сам в режиме EV
model_faults.likely_cause: Engine runs to purge the saturated fuel-vapour canister (per BYD manual as reported)
model_faults.repair_action: Usually normal behaviour; dealer check if frequent with a charged battery
model_faults.caveat: Complaint ranking (12365Auto) — not a defect finding
